method: Fetched primary official documentation; no training-data claims. Common categories are cross-validated by independent Framer/Webflow documentation, while each vendor-specific implementation fact remains explicitly single-organization evidence. Unknown is not absence.

source_conflicts.resolution: W23 sunset overrides retained User Accounts references in older W26 export docs; native memberships are retired.

source_conflicts.issue: Native Framer MCP versus agent connectivity
source_conflicts.resolution: F19 describes constructing MCP atop Server API; F23 documents native agent CLI which does not require manual MCP. Do not claim official Framer hosted MCP equivalence.

source_conflicts.issue: Webflow whole-site code export versus DevLink
source_conflicts.resolution: W26 site ZIP export and W27 React component export are different products with different functionality.

source_policy: Product capability evidence is vendor authored, so vendor-only flags are retained. Actual FormWeb coverage must come from code plus executed runtime evidence, not target plans.
